suppress.notes: CVE-2026-40974 (CRITICAL 9.8) — Spring Boot Cassandra auto-configuration omits SSL hostname verification. NOT APPLICABLE: this application declares no Cassandra dependency (no spring-boot-starter-data-cassandra; verified absent from the dependency tree), so the vulnerable CassandraAutoConfiguration code path is not on the classpath and cannot execute. Fixed in Spring Boot 3.5.14; the parent is frozen at 3.5.11 by AAP Sec 0.5.1. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-40971 (CRITICAL 9.1) — Spring Boot RabbitMQ auto-configuration omits SSL hostname verification when an SSL bundle is used. NOT APPLICABLE: this application declares no AMQP/RabbitMQ dependency (no spring-boot-starter-amqp; verified absent), so RabbitAutoConfiguration is not on the classpath. Fixed in 3.5.14; parent frozen at 3.5.11 by AAP Sec 0.5.1. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-22731 (HIGH 8.1) — Actuator authentication bypass when an auth-required endpoint is declared under a path also configured as a Health Group "additional-path". NOT APPLICABLE: this application configures no health-group additional-path (management.endpoint.health.group.readiness uses only include: readinessState,db in application.yml — no additional-path), and actuator is bound to an isolated, non- published management port 9091 (DECISION_LOG D-033). The vulnerable mapping does not exist. Fixed in 3.5.12; parent frozen at 3.5.11 by AAP Sec 0.5.1. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-22733 (HIGH 8.1) — Actuator authentication bypass via the CloudFoundry actuator endpoint path. NOT APPLICABLE: this application has no CloudFoundry integration (no cloudfoundry configuration or dependency; verified absent), so the CloudFoundry actuator endpoint is never registered. Fixed in 3.5.12; parent frozen at 3.5.11 by AAP Sec 0.5.1. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-40972 (HIGH 7.5) — Timing attack against the Spring Boot DevTools remote secret used to upload changed classes. NOT APPLICABLE: this application does not use Spring Boot DevTools (no spring-boot-devtools dependency; verified absent) and exposes no remote DevTools endpoint. Fixed in 3.5.14; parent frozen at 3.5.11 by AAP Sec 0.5.1. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-40975 (HIGH 7.5) — The ${random.value} property placeholder is not a suitable source of cryptographic secrets. NOT APPLICABLE: this application does not use ${random.value} (verified absent from sources and resources); secrets (JWT_SECRET, datasource credentials) are supplied via environment variables / .env per AAP "no hardcoded credentials". Advisory addressed in 3.5.14; parent frozen at 3.5.11 by AAP Sec 0.5.1. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-40973 (HIGH 7.0) — A local attacker can hijack the ApplicationTemp directory when server.servlet.session.persistent=true. NOT APPLICABLE: this application does not enable persistent sessions (server.servlet.session.persistent is not set to true; verified absent) and is a stateless JWT REST service with no server-side session persistence (AAP stateless session model). Fixed in 3.5.14; parent frozen at 3.5.11 by AAP Sec 0.5.1. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-34478 (HIGH 7.5) — FALSE POSITIVE. The advisory affects Apache Log4j CORE's Rfc5424Layout (a class shipped in log4j-core). The classpath contains only log4j-api-2.24.3 (the API facade) and log4j-to-slf4j-2.24.3 (the bridge routing the Log4j2 API to SLF4J/Logback); log4j-core is NOT present (verified: 0 matches in the dependency tree). The vulnerable Layout classes do not exist on the classpath and this application uses Logback (logback-spring.xml), not Log4j2. dependency-check matched the log4j-core advisory to the log4j-api jar via the shared cpe:apache:log4j. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-34479 (HIGH 7.5) — FALSE POSITIVE. Affects Apache Log4j CORE's Log4j1XmlLayout (Log4j 1->2 bridge layout, shipped in log4j-core). log4j-core is absent (only log4j-api facade + log4j-to-slf4j bridge present); the application uses Logback. Same cpe over- match as CVE-2026-34478. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-34480 (HIGH 7.5) — FALSE POSITIVE. Affects Apache Log4j CORE's XmlLayout (shipped in log4j-core). log4j-core is absent (only log4j-api facade + log4j-to-slf4j bridge present); the application uses Logback. Same cpe over-match as CVE-2026-34478. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-34481 (HIGH 7.5) — FALSE POSITIVE. Affects Apache Log4j CORE's JsonTemplateLayout (shipped in log4j-core). log4j-core is absent (only log4j-api facade + log4j-to-slf4j bridge present); the application uses Logback. Same cpe over-match as CVE-2026-34478. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2025-7962 (HIGH 7.5) — FALSE POSITIVE. The advisory is an SMTP injection in Jakarta Mail / Eclipse Angus MAIL versions prior to 2.0.2 (cpe:eclipse:jakarta_mail, cpe:eclipse:angus_mail). The flagged artifact is org.eclipse.angus:angus-ACTIVATION 2.0.3 — the Jakarta Activation implementation, a different artifact that contains no mail/SMTP code. This application declares no Jakarta Mail / angus-mail dependency (verified: 0 matches) and performs no mail/SMTP operations (no JavaMailSender / jakarta.mail usage in sources). Wrong-artifact CPE match. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-42154 (HIGH 7.5) — FALSE POSITIVE. The advisory affects the Prometheus monitoring SERVER's /api/v1/read remote-read endpoint (snappy decompression memory allocation); its fixed versions 3.5.3 / 3.11.3 are Prometheus-server releases. The flagged artifact is io.micrometer:micrometer-registry-prometheus 1.15.9 — a Java client library that EXPORTS metrics in Prometheus text format and embeds no Prometheus server and no /api/v1/read endpoint. Wrong-product CPE match (prometheus server vs micrometer client). See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-39883 (HIGH 7.0) — FALSE POSITIVE. The advisory affects the OpenTelemetry-GO SDK (a PATH-hijacking issue on Darwin/macOS; fixed in Go module v1.43.0). The flagged artifact is the Java io.opentelemetry.semconv:opentelemetry-semconv 1.32.0 (a passive semantic-conventions constants jar). Different language/product (Go SDK vs Java jar) and Darwin-specific; this service runs on Linux. Wrong-product CPE match. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-24051 (HIGH 7.0) — FALSE POSITIVE. Same family as CVE-2026-39883: an OpenTelemetry-GO Darwin/macOS PATH-hijacking issue (fixed in Go module v1.40.0). The flagged artifact is the Java opentelemetry-semconv 1.32.0 constants jar. Different language/product and Darwin-specific; runtime is Linux. Wrong-product CPE match. See DECISION_LOG D-055.

CVE-2026-42582 (HIGH 7.5) — NOT APPLICABLE. The advisory is in Netty's HTTP/3 QPACK decoder (io.netty.handler.codec.http3.QpackDecoder unbounded allocation). This application is a servlet (Tomcat) REST service and does NOT use Netty HTTP/3: the netty-codec-http3 module is not on the classpath and no HTTP/3 listener is configured. Several netty modules (netty-transport, netty-transport-classes-epoll, netty-codec, netty-handler, ...) are present transitively (AWS SDK async client) and share the generic cpe:netty:netty:4.1.135 CPE, so dependency-check flags this HTTP/3 advisory on each of them; the packageUrl regex below therefore scopes the suppression to ALL io.netty modules at the pinned version. The vulnerable QPACK decoder is never instantiated in any of them on this servlet stack. The fix is netty 4.2.13.Final, a 4.1->4.2 minor-line migration with compatibility risk against the AWS SDK; netty is pinned to 4.1.135.Final by DECISION_LOG D-034. See DECISION_LOG D-055.
